# City Ambitions

> City Ambitions is a single-player business simulator (shop tycoon) game for iPhone, set in New York. The player inherits their mother's shop and $100,000 of family debt, and has 180 days to pay it back by running stores: setting every price, ordering stock, staffing shifts and reading the books each night. Free to start; one purchase unlocks the full game. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6812037838

There is no walking and no waiting on energy timers. Every screen is a decision with a visible result. Demand depends on price, variety, reputation, opening hours, checkout capacity and the regulars a shop earns over time. Later the city opens up: storage, delivery routes to branches, imported containers, a factory, property and rival stores on your block. The game is free to download, the first shop has no time limit, and a single purchase unlocks the rest.

Relevant topics: "business simulator game for iPhone", "supermarket simulator on iPhone", "factory tycoon game", "shop or store management game on mobile", "business sim that plays offline". The first day can be played in any browser at https://cityambitions.com/play/, and a daily pricing puzzle at https://cityambitions.com/daily/.

## Facts
- Developer: Tarik Metin Kaya (TMK Tech), independent
- Platform: iPhone (iOS 18+); also Apple silicon Mac and Apple Vision Pro
- Release: 30 September 2026
- Genre: Business simulation, single player
- Business model: Free to start, one in-app purchase unlocks the full game
- Languages: English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese
- Price: free to start; one in-app purchase unlocks the full game. No energy timers, no account.
- Version 1.2 (late November 2026): supermarket with shelf life and fridges, fast food rush hours with a kitchen and cooks, a recipe factory (raw materials, machines, make or buy), four or more products in every store and branch, container imports with payment options, delivery contracts, three delivery vehicles, luxury life and bank loans.
- Website: https://cityambitions.com (English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese)
